facts.text: I am thinking of getting a second car.
I am considering an electric or hybrid second car to reduce our carbon footprint.
I want second-car models similar to the Toyota Prius but more affordable.
I renewed my car insurance last week on April 15.
My car insurance premium increased by only $20 per month.
I want more compact second-car models like the Honda Fit or Toyota Yaris.
My wife and I are thinking of using the second car for short trips and running errands around town.
My current car is a Honda Civic.
I am considering getting a bike rack for my car.
I have recently gotten back into cycling.
I want bike rack types compatible with my Honda Civic.
I am considering roof-mounted bike racks for my car.
My bike is a Trek FX 3.
I want to find bike shops in my area that sell and install bike racks.
I would rather have a professional install the bike rack.
I will check out options and find a reputable bike shop in my area to install the rack.
